title: B01 template-local conservative closure scientific pre-screen
purpose: Characterize the simplest template-local reduced dynamics on held-out B01 histories and determine whether any declared application lens remains scientifically plausible before direct-route timing and coarse-Richards comparison.

state_definition.reason: Carry total storage explicitly so conservation is structural rather than an after-the-fact mass correction.
state_definition.reconstruction_for_physical_bounds: For cells 1-14, use each 20-cm band mean Zi for both 10-cm cells; for cells 15-16 use Z8+G8 and Z8-G8. This is a reduced-state reconstruction diagnostic, not a claim of full-profile fidelity.

training_pairs.rule: Within each discovery history use accepted state k as input and accepted state k+1 plus interval outputs as target for k=1..63.

closure.fit_method: ordinary least squares using SVD pseudoinverse; no heldout tuning; no ridge hyperparameter
closure.state_standardization: discovery mean and standard deviation only
closure.top_exchange: taken exactly from the declared forcing interval, not learned

ood_gate.state_rule: All nine regression-state coordinates must lie within the closed discovery min/max range.
ood_gate.forcing_rule: The exact tuple (u_top,u_bottom,u_head_mode) must occur in discovery training pairs.
ood_gate.decision: If either rule fails, classify OUTSIDE_QUALIFIED_DOMAIN and use the full-order recorded transition in the hybrid replay.

evaluation.pure_rom: Starting from exact heldout accepted step 1, recursively predict steps 2..64 without fallback for diagnostic failure characterization.
evaluation.hybrid: Starting from exact heldout accepted step 1, use reduced transition only when the frozen OOD gate passes; otherwise publish the recorded full-order transition and continue from that full-order accepted state.

stage1_decision.not_allowed: No Stage-1 result can authorize production ROM, universal Richards equivalence, or final MDE success.
integrity_kill_if: Any in-domain hybrid reduced transition produces nonfinite state.
Any reconstructed in-domain hybrid water content lies outside B01 physical [theta_r,theta_s]=[0.02,0.427494].
Any in-domain hybrid reduced transition violates the structural water ledger by more than 1e-12 cm.
OOD gate publishes a reduced transition for a state or forcing outside its frozen discovery envelope.
stage1_decision.fidelity_rule: Event timing, flux sign, storage, exchange and bias errors are evaluated separately under the declared application lenses. Failure of an event-sensitive lens does not automatically fail a long-term-balance lens. No fixed percentage tolerance is introduced after observing heldout results.
stage1_decision.advance_rule: Proceed only if integrity constraints pass and at least one application lens remains scientifically plausible enough to justify the preregistered direct-route/coarse-Richards cost-fidelity comparison. Stage 1 may also close a lens as unsuitable while leaving another open.

stage1_scope.limitation: ET and full groundwater-head feedback are not present in the ROM1AR2 pure-hydraulics laboratory.
This is not yet a live MODFLOW coupling qualification.
Failure here does not automatically invalidate long-term-balance use.
The nine-state representation is not required to reproduce the complete pressure-head profile.

threshold_policy: No universal percentage or numerical-equivalence tolerance. ROM-0 floors are retained as measurement context. Any later application acceptance envelope must be justified from the intended use before final qualification.
computational_cost_stage1: Only Python-level closure evaluation cost may be recorded diagnostically. Formal value is deferred to the direct comparator stage on an admitted performance host.
